dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Mr. Brown, are you free on Sunday evening?
dialogue.reading: ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn, ər juː ˈfriː ɑːn ˈsʌndeɪ ˈiːvnɪŋ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Our university is having a charity run to raise money for an orphanage.
dialogue.reading: aʊər ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti ɪz ˈhævɪŋ ə ˈtʃærəti ˌrʌn tə ˈreɪz ˈmʌni fər ən ˈɔːrfənɪdʒ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's a good cause. How far is it?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ə ˈɡʊd ˈkɔːz. ˈhaʊ ˈfɑːr ɪz ɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Only five kilometers. You can walk it if you want.
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊnli ˈfaɪv kɪˈlɑːmətərz. juː kən ˈwɔːk ɪt ɪf juː ˈwɑːnt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Ha! Do I have to pay to join?
dialogue.reading: ˈhɑː! duː aɪ ˈhæf tə ˈpeɪ tə ˈdʒɔɪn?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, five hundred baht. All the money goes to the orphanage.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ˈfaɪv ˈhʌndrəd ˈbɑːt. ˈɔːl ðə ˈmʌni ˈɡoʊz tə ði ˈɔːrfənɪdʒ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Then I'll do it. Is the run for the orphanage every year?
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn aɪl ˈduː ɪt. ɪz ðə ˈrʌn fər ði ˈɔːrfənɪdʒ ˈɛvri ˈjɪr?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No. Last year, it was for homeless people. This year, it's for the children.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ. ˈlæst ˈjɪr, ɪt wʌz fər ˈhoʊmləs ˈpiːpəl. ðɪs ˈjɪr, ɪts fər ðə ˈtʃɪldrən.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: What are you doing to prepare?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt ər juː ˈduːɪŋ tə prɪˈpɛr?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I'm running every evening for practice. And I'm asking all my friends to join.
dialogue.reading: aɪm ˈrʌnɪŋ ˈɛvri ˈiːvnɪŋ fər ˈpræktɪs. ənd aɪm ˈæskɪŋ ˈɔːl maɪ ˈfrɛndz tə ˈdʒɔɪn.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I'll be there. Running for a good cause is good for my health, too!
dialogue.reading: aɪl bi ˈðɛr. ˈrʌnɪŋ fər ə ˈɡʊd ˈkɔːz ɪz ˈɡʊd fər maɪ ˈhɛlθ, ˈtuː!
